verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime novel first-book-publication span, from The Lying Days to No Time Like the Present, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The eight selected markers use original English-language book years, not composition, periodical serialization, later national editions, reissues or translations. The Conservationist uses the 1974 Jonathan Cape publication. Earlier short fiction and story collections, including Face to Face (1949), are outside this novel-only bar. Essays, journalism, lectures, later story collections and posthumous releases are also excluded; the endpoint marks her final novel, not the end of all literary activity.
